processing: Original source RGB for original valid moon region; up to6px seam allowance reuses nearest verified lunar edge color. No synthesized colors or other scene pixels.
purpose: Surface artwork on existing foreground moon geometry, not a background or replacement scene.
limitations: Photographic shading is baked into the artwork and intended for the calibrated fixed viewing direction. Mobile/reframed areas outside crop fall back to native material.
saturnFeasibility: Possible, but its foreground ring must be masked separately to avoid painting gold ring pixels onto globe; not implemented.

edgeBleed.method: Nearest-neighbor color extension from verified interior lunar texels only, followed by2px alpha feather; no background/ring/companion pixels sampled.
